result.reason: The transition-assistance obligation reaches the preferred six-month position at then-current rates, and the original commercial terms remain unchanged. However, the data-export deadline runs from Customer’s request rather than from expiry or termination. Customer could therefore receive no export within 30 days after termination, contrary to the playbook. Deletion and certification are also deferred until after that request-based export. The insertion is otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, although deletion certification should expressly identify any data retained under the backup and legal-retention exceptions.
